title: Fix Nam Jap count saving, add Radha Nam & Jai Shree Ram options, and add animations

requirements.text: Add Radha Nam (राधा नाम) and Jai Shree Ram (जय श्री राम) as selectable mantra/name options in the Nam Jap (Jap.tsx) page, alongside existing options. Each option must be selectable and update the Jap counter context accordingly.

quotes: isme radha nam or jai shree ram nam bhi nahi hai nam jap ke liye to isse thik kro

acceptanceCriteria: Radha Nam (राधा नाम) option appears in the name/mantra selector on the Jap page
Jai Shree Ram (जय श्री राम) option appears in the name/mantra selector on the Jap page
Selecting either option updates the displayed mantra name and the Jap counter context
Previously existing mantra options remain functional

requirements.text: Fix the Nam Jap count persistence so that: (a) the count is saved to localStorage for session/temporary persistence so it survives page refreshes, and (b) for authenticated users the count is synced and saved to the backend canister for permanent persistence. On page load, restore the count from backend (if authenticated) or localStorage (if guest).

quotes: ye save nahi kr raha hai isme nam jap count na hi temporary or na hi permanant

acceptanceCriteria: Jap count persists in localStorage so refreshing the page does not reset the count for guest users
For authenticated users, the Jap count is saved to the backend canister and restored on page load
Switching between mantras saves and restores the correct count per mantra
Count is not lost when navigating away from the Jap page and returning

requirements.text: Add meaningful animations to the Nam Jap (Jap.tsx) section. This should include: a smooth ripple or glow pulse effect on the main tap/count button each time it is pressed, a subtle entrance animation for the mala bead ring and counter display when the page loads, and a celebratory animation (e.g., divine light burst or petal shower) when a full mala (108 counts) is completed.

quotes: Thoda animation kro nam jap me

acceptanceCriteria: Each tap on the Jap count button triggers a visible ripple or glow pulse animation on the button
The mala ring and counter display animate in smoothly when the Jap page first loads
Completing 108 counts triggers a celebratory visual animation (light burst, petal shower, or similar devotional effect)
Animations are smooth and do not cause layout shifts or performance degradation

constraints: Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths
All Motoko logic must remain in the single backend/main.mo actor file
Existing mantra options must not be removed
nonGoals: Redesigning the overall visual theme of the app
Changes to other pages (Home, Panchang, AI Guru, etc.)
Adding new backend data types unrelated to Jap count persistence
